description: This file defines the interface and class declarations for the PackageManagerImplementation, which manages package downloading, installation, and handling within the WPEFramework plugin. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and internal data structures related to package management operations.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Represents the internal state of a package, including installation status, configuration, paths, and locks.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Configuration container for package manager settings, such as download directory.

classes.name: DownloadInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a download task, including URL, retries, rate limits, and status.

methods.name: getRuntimeConfig
methods.description: Static method to populate runtime configuration from package metadata or existing config.

methods.name: createStorageManagerObject
methods.description: Creates the storage manager object used by the package manager.

methods.name: releaseStorageManagerObject
methods.description: Releases or cleans up the storage manager object.
